lines.text: Build your own decision models with JevAny.
We provide open checkpoints and the infrastructure for research, training, and deployment.
Start from a released checkpoint or one of 26 supported open models, and keep every step in one repository.
Five checkpoints, from 4 B to 30 B, come with benchmark results. Serve one, or fine-tune from it.
Write your own decisions as JSON lines: a state, the questions and their labels, with text, images or video.
Train from a recipe file, on one GPU or many with the same recipe. Choose a pointer or direct-token head, or continue with experimental RLCR for calibrated probabilities.
Evaluate on held-out data, with accuracy and calibration side by side. Runs save their recipe, optimizer and data order, so you can resume and compare training paradigms.
Serve the checkpoint you trained behind one API. Your applications get choices and probabilities through HTTP or the Python client.
In agent loops, the LLM plans and Jev takes the repeated choices.
JevAny is open source under Apache 2.0. Find it on GitHub, at SimpleJev slash JevAny.
